decisions.evidence: The pre-reader Definition applied homotopy fibers to arbitrary maps but its cited published definition only specifies based maps. The added Remarks give the same mapping-path space without a source basepoint and prove invariance under changing the target point by path concatenation. This resolves a nonfatal convention/citation ambiguity, not an erroneous homotopy weight. The Definition section and all supplier/consumer interfaces are unchanged. Step 1.1 now explicitly takes the fiber of Map(x,x)^equiv→Map(x,z), so loops of the arrow core exclude noninvertible endomorphisms. The pre-reader text already named equivalences before introducing the underlying full endomorphism mapping space, but omitted the explicit component restriction when extracting the stabilizer tail. This is a nonfatal proof-explanation repair; the full finite exact sequence and alternating weight are correct with the explicit restriction. Toën §5 Proposition 5.1 PDF pp.16–18 confirms the stabilizer sequence. The pre-reader first-pullback description referred to the cofiber of induced k before reconstructing a composable pair. The actual pullback records an object identified with Cone(g). The repaired step explicitly transports the middle equivalence, explains the contractible space of cofiber-identification data, and uses the recomputed Cone(k)≈Cone(g) coordinate change to identify the comparison map. The original cone computation and both square claims remain valid; this corrects a nonfatal description and comparison gap. Toën §4 PDF pp.10–16 supplies the same squares and stable reconstruction.
